cohort_definition: Primary episode-based longitudinal inpatient cohort: each exact transplant-coded index admission plus all subsequent MIMIC admissions through 365 days, assigned to the most recent preceding transplant episode.; medication decisions anchored to exact subject+admission+poe_id ordertime, with prescription starttime fallback for missing or invalid POE linkage
transplant_episode_policy: Distinct exact transplant-coded admissions are separate candidate transplant episodes; each non-index admission is assigned to the most recent preceding episode.
transplant_anchor_quality_policy: Exact single in-admission chartdate preferred; earliest valid date used for multiple valid dates; admission date used as flagged proxy when chartdate lies outside the stay.
